title: EtiCor++: Towards Understanding Etiquettical Bias in LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for 'etiquettes', which it defines as social norms and rules for behavior. The dataset and evaluation tasks include numerous scenarios involving religious practices (e.g., fasting during Ramadan, halal requirements) and moral/social conventions across different cultures, assessing how LLMs perceive the 'acceptability' of these behaviors.
